observations: All three photos show the same used automatic transmission/transaxle unit (bell housing, torque converter visible) sitting in a yard full of other stripped engines and gearboxes.
A paper/sticker label is visible on the casing in all photos but the text is too small/blurry to read.
A rubber/plastic line stamped '1/2in SAE J1532...' is visible near the top in photos 0-2, but this is a hose spec, not a part or vehicle identifier.
Wiring harness near the bottom of the unit (photo 0, 1) appears cut and loose, with exposed strands.
Casing is dirty, oxidized in places, with dust/grime consistent with yard storage; no fluid, no test rig, no vehicle attached.

risks.proof: Close-up, in-focus photo of the casting part number / manufacturer tag / sticker on the transmission body.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified-fitment used gearbox, not confirmed Ford Fusion specific

risks.risk: Internal condition (clutch packs, torque converter, solenoids) cannot be assessed from exterior photos; cut/loose wiring suggests rough removal.
risks.proof: Video of the unit being spun by hand or bench-tested, plus close-up of the wiring harness connectors.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for-parts condition

risks.risk: No mileage, accident, or flood history is shown; yard storage exposure could mean rust or water ingress inside.
risks.proof: Photos of the fluid pan/dipstick and drained fluid color, or a yard history/invoice.

risks.risk: Seller only offers to match 'engine capacity' verbally, with no documentation of compatibility across Fusion model years/engines.
risks.proof: Screenshot or photo of a compatibility chart or the specific Fusion year/trim this unit was pulled from.

proof_requests: Clear, in-focus close-up of the part number / casting number / manufacturer tag on the transmission casing.
Photo or video showing the VIN plate or tag of the donor Ford Fusion this gearbox was removed from.
Video of the input/output shafts being turned by hand to show free rotation, or a bench spin test.
Photo of the wiring harness connectors (currently shown cut/loose) to assess completeness.
response.reason: The item's value hinges entirely on confirmed vehicle/engine fitment (Ford Fusion, 4-cylinder), but no part number, casting mark, or VIN tag is legible in any photo, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored to the right comparable without that proof.
